name: Exp_SSL_NRTR_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA combines the SSL (Squeeze Signal Line) trend indicator with the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) dynamic trailing stop system to identify and follow trends, with an added time filter to restrict trading to specific sessions. It enters trades when SSL confirms trend direction and NRTR confirms a trailing reversal signal, then manages positions with NRTR-based trailing stops. The time filter prevents trading during undesirable market hours.
summary_zh: 该EA结合SSL趋势指标和NRTR动态追踪止损系统来识别和跟随趋势，并添加了时间过滤器限制在特定时段交易。当SSL确认趋势方向且NRTR确认追踪反转信号时入场，然后使用基于NRTR的追踪止损管理仓位。时间过滤器防止在不理想的市场时段进行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重确认的趋势跟踪系统：SSL指标通过高点和低点的简单移动平均线交叉来判断趋势方向，当高点SMA在低点SMA之上时为上升趋势，反之为下降趋势。NRTR指标则提供一个动态追踪止损水平，当价格突破NRTR水平时产生入场或反转信号。入场条件要求SSL趋势方向与NRTR突破方向一致，形成双重过滤，减少虚假信号。出场条件主要依赖NRTR追踪止损，当价格回撤触及NRTR水平时平仓，同时可能包含固定止损和止盈作为辅助出场。仓位管理通常支持固定手数或基于资金的动态计算。时间过滤器允许用户指定交易时段，避免低流动性或高波动时段的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual-confirmation trend-following system: the SSL indicator determines trend direction through crossovers of SMA calculated on highs and SMA calculated on lows, with the high SMA above the low SMA signaling an uptrend and vice versa. The NRTR indicator provides a dynamic trailing stop level that generates entry or reversal signals when price breaks through the NRTR level. Entry conditions require the SSL trend direction to align with the NRTR breakout direction, forming a dual filter that reduces false signals. Exit conditions primarily rely on the NRTR trailing stop, closing positions when price retraces to the NRTR level, with possible fixed stop-loss and take-profit as auxiliary exits. Position sizing typically supports fixed lots or equity-based dynamic calculation. The time filter allows users to specify trading sessions, avoiding risk during low-liquidity or high-volatility periods.

pros: 双重确认机制（SSL+NRTR）减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
NRTR动态追踪止损能有效锁定趋势利润，适应不同波动环境
时间过滤器避免在不利时段交易，降低隔夜和低流动性风险
pros_en: Dual confirmation mechanism (SSL+NRTR) reduces false signals and improves entry quality
NRTR dynamic trailing stop effectively locks in trend profits and adapts to varying volatility environments
Time filter avoids trading during unfavorable sessions, reducing overnight and low-liquidity risk
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损，缺乏震荡识别机制
NRTR参数在不同市场条件下需要频繁优化，过度拟合风险较高
缺乏完善的资金管理和仓位缩放机制，可能在连续亏损时造成较大回撤
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets, lacking range identification mechanism
NRTR parameters require frequent optimization across different market conditions, posing overfitting risk
Lacks comprehensive money management and position scaling, potentially causing significant drawdowns during losing streaks
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块（如ADX或波动率过滤器），在震荡行情中自动暂停交易或切换策略
加入基于波动率（ATR）的动态仓位管理和止损计算，替代固定参数，提高策略适应性
improvements_en: Add market regime identification module (e.g., ADX or volatility filter) to auto-pause trading or switch strategy in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic position sizing and stop-loss calculation instead of fixed parameters to improve strategy adaptability

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能频繁开仓平仓造成连续亏损
缺乏最大回撤保护和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy may frequently open and close positions in ranging markets causing consecutive losses
Lacks maximum drawdown protection and position reduction mechanism after consecutive losses

It enters trades when SSL confirms trend direction and NRTR confirms a trailing reversal signal, then manages positions with NRTR-based trailing stops. The time filter prevents trading during undesirable market hours.
